BrochureContent.Content:
Marion Earner LWK PREMIUM  is delighted to present this exceptional 3 Bed 2 Bath extended Family home, ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac setting within the ever-popular St. Maelruan's Park. No.53 comes to the market in excellent condition throughout, having been lovingly maintained, extended, and modernized over the years to create a truly charming family home. Built in the mid-1950s, this solid and well-constructed property has been tastefully refurbished and upgraded, offering bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout. One of its standout features is the rear garden space and the large side garden with an extended family room providing a wonderful and private outdoor space perfect for relaxing and entertaining.

St. Maelruan's Park enjoys a superb location directly across from Tallaght Village, placing every conceivable amenity on your doorstep from shops, cafés, and restaurants to bars and local services. The property is also within easy reach of the Luas Red Line, providing swift access to the city centre, while several Dublin Bus routes are just a short stroll away. The Square Shopping Centre, Tallaght Hospital, TU Dublin Tallaght Campus, The Civic Theatre, cinemas, and excellent primary and secondary schools are all within walking distance. A local public park and enclosed children's playground sit just beside the estate entrance, adding to the area's family-friendly appeal.

To the front, the property is set on a large plot featuring a driveway that provides ample off-street parking. Mature trees and shrubbery create excellent privacy and curb appeal. A wide side entrance leads to the wonderful side garden, beautifully landscaped for minimal maintenance. With  mature planting, this private outdoor haven is perfect for relaxing or entertaining and offers exciting possibilities for a further extension or development (S.P.P.).

Upon entering no 53 you are welcomed by a bright and spacious hallway. To the right we enter into the  front reception  room featuring a  Bay window and open fireplace and overlooking the front garden, to the rear a fully fitted, modernised kitchen featuring ample storage and workspace with access to the rear garden space and leading onto the extended Dining area and family room with patio doors leading out to the exceptional side garden ideal for family life and entertaining.The ground floor also benefits from a utility room and Guest WC.
Upstairs, there are three generous bedrooms and a modern fully tiled family bathroom. A large attic space could also be converted in the future( S.P.P.)

This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a beautiful, extended turnkey three-bedroom home in a mature and convenient location with tremendous future potential.

Early viewing is highly recommended.

***All information provided is to the best of our knowledge. The utmost of care and attention has been placed on providing factual and correct information. In certain cases some information may have been provided by the vendor to us. We do not hold any responsibility for mistakes, errors or inaccuracies in our online advertising and give each and every viewer the right to get an opinion on any concern they may have***
